product_one_liner.value: Luciq is an agentic mobile observability platform that helps mobile engineering teams detect, prioritize, and resolve app issues.
product_one_liner.notes: The descriptions at https://www.luciq.ai/ and https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/luciq identify mobile engineering teams as the audience and describe agents that detect, prioritize, and resolve app issues.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page exists at https://www.luciq.ai/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company announcement at https://luciq.ai/blog/instabug-becomes-luciq explicitly says its platform powers DoorDash and T-Mobile, among other customers. | named_customers.0: https://luciq.ai/blog/instabug-becomes-luciq names DoorDash among apps powered by the platform. | named_customers.1: https://luciq.ai/blog/instabug-becomes-luciq names T-Mobile among apps powered by the platform.

employee_band.notes: The company profile at https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/luciq reports a team size of 250, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company announcement at https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20220517005310/en/Instabug-Raises-46M-Series-B explicitly identifies San Francisco as headquarters. Luciq's DPA at https://www.luciq.ai/dpa also gives its principal place of business there. | hq_country: The company announcement at https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20220517005310/en/Instabug-Raises-46M-Series-B identifies San Francisco as headquarters; the legal address at https://www.luciq.ai/privacy explicitly places it in the United States.

founded_year.notes: Luciq's own history at https://www.luciq.ai/life-at-luciq dates the founders' start to 2013. This primary account is preferred over inconsistent secondary founding dates.

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying posts explain Luciq's own implementation: Mohamed Aziz's ClickHouse infrastructure article at https://www.luciq.ai/blog/clickhouse-s3-write-cost-reduction and Khaled Elmorabea's SDK architecture article at https://www.luciq.ai/blog/ai-native-engineering-legacy-rewrite. Engineering roles are supported by https://linkedin.com/in/mo-azizz and https://theorg.com/org/luciq/org-chart/khaled-el-morabea.

public_docs.notes: The public portal at https://docs.luciq.ai/ links separate articles including How Luciq Works, Product Guides, and Inbox, alongside SDK and developer-tool documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official current-openings board at https://instabug.bamboohr.com/careers lists only Enterprise Account Executive and Product Engineer (Backend), neither of which qualifies under the specified title rule. This official list is preferred over an undated third-party AI product-manager entry.

model_provider.notes: Luciq's subprocessor documentation at https://docs.luciq.ai/organization-settings/others/sub-processors explicitly lists OpenAI, LLC for AI-powered product features.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The FAQ at https://www.luciq.ai/faq explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 certification and GDPR compliance. | compliance_certs.0: https://www.luciq.ai/faq explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II certification. | compliance_certs.1: https://www.luciq.ai/faq explicitly claims ISO 27001:2022 certification. | compliance_certs.2: https://www.luciq.ai/faq explicitly claims GDPR compliance with a DPA.

Funding history at https://tracxn.com identifies that May 2022 Series B as the latest round; the answer uses the company's announced dollar amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded funding round is the May 17, 2022 Series B, announced at https://blog.instabug.com/instabug-raises-46m-series-b. It predates the requested 18-month window beginning in May 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official hiring board lists Enterprise Account Executive, and its live posting at https://instabug.bamboohr.com/careers/33 includes an application action.

launched_6mo.notes: The dated changelog at https://docs.luciq.ai/changelog/rss.xml announces the Luciq Agent dashboard AI assistant beta on August 5, 2026, inside the six-month window. This is a new major feature rather than a bug fix or UI tweak.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The announcement at https://www.luciq.ai/blog/luciq-welcomes-greg-meyer-as-cfo says Greg Meyer has joined as CFO and carries an October 4, 2026 publication date, within the requested window. It does not provide a separate exact joining date.
